title: Textile Bleaching and Dyeing Machine Operators and Tenders
description: Operate or tend machines to bleach, shrink, wash, dye, or finish textiles or synthetic or glass fibers.

projection.title: Textile bleaching and dyeing machine operators and tenders

tasks.text: Weigh ingredients, such as dye, to be mixed together for use in textile processing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measuring and dispensing of ingredients

dwas.name: Measure ingredients or substances to be used in production processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Start and control machines and equipment to wash, bleach, dye, or otherwise process and finish fabric, yarn, thread, or other textile goods.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on operation of garment treatment machinery

dwas.name: Operate garment treatment equipment.

tasks.text: Observe display screens, control panels, equipment, and cloth entering or exiting processes to determine if equipment is operating correctly.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Notify supervisors or mechanics of equipment malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Notifying maintenance needs is routine messaging

dwas.name: Notify others of equipment repair or maintenance needs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Monitor factors such as temperatures and dye flow rates to ensure that they are within specified ranges.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical product flaw monitoring is on-machine

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure that products are not flawed.

tasks.text: Add dyes, water, detergents, or chemicals to tanks to dilute or strengthen solutions, according to established formulas and solution test results.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying solutions to equipment is manual

dwas.name: Apply solutions to production equipment.

tasks.text: Examine and feel products to identify defects and variations from coloring and other processing standards.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Textile inspection is tactile and visual, hands-on

dwas.name: Inspect textile products.

tasks.text: Adjust equipment controls to maintain specified heat, tension, and speed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Operate garment treatment equipment.
Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Soak specified textile products for designated times.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Immersing workpieces in solutions by hand

dwas.name: Immerse objects or workpieces in cleaning or coating solutions.

tasks.text: Inspect machinery to determine necessary adjustments and repairs.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of production machinery in situ

dwas.name: Inspect production equipment.

tasks.text: Confer with coworkers to get information about order details, processing plans, or problems that occur.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Colleague information exchange is relational, contextual

dwas.name: Exchange information with colleagues.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Sew ends of cloth together, by hand or using machines, to form endless lengths of cloth to facilitate processing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sewing clothing requires fine manual dexterity

dwas.name: Sew clothing or other articles.

tasks.text: Ravel seams that connect cloth ends when processing is completed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sewing materials is tactile hands-on craft

dwas.name: Sew materials.

tasks.text: Remove dyed articles from tanks and machines for drying and further processing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Study guides, charts, and specification sheets, and confer with supervisors to determine machine setup requirements.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprint setup reading partial, human confirms

dwas.name: Study blueprints or other instructions to determine equipment setup requirements.
Exchange information with colleagues.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Prepare dyeing machines for production runs, and conduct test runs of machines to ensure their proper operation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating production equipment physically on site

dwas.name: Conduct test runs of production equipment.

tasks.text: Key in processing instructions to program electronic equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Command entry often needs physical equipment interface

dwas.name: Enter commands, instructions, or specifications into equipment.

tasks.text: Test solutions used to process textile goods to detect variations from standards.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical/physical testing requires lab manipulation

dwas.name: Test chemical or physical characteristics of materials or products.

tasks.text: Record production information such as fabric yardage processed, temperature readings, fabric tensions, and machine speeds.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Thread ends of cloth or twine through specified sections of equipment prior to processing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Feeding materials into equipment is physical

dwas.name: Feed materials or products into or through equipment.

tasks.text: Mount rolls of cloth on machines, using hoists, or place textile goods in machines or pieces of equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Rigging and lifting loads with cranes is hands-on

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.
Lift materials or workpieces using cranes or other lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Install, level, and align components such as gears, chains, dies, cutters, and needles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Install mechanical components in production equipment.

tasks.text: Perform machine maintenance, such as cleaning and oiling equipment, and repair or replace worn or defective parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on repair of production machinery

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Repair production equipment or tools.
Maintain production or processing equipment.
